'''Ariela's sister''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who was the sister of [[Ariela]]. She was present at [[Eyvind/Legends|Eyvind]] and her sister's wedding ceremony when young [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] killed Eyvind and took Ariela.
